titre: Les métiers qui achètent les outils recrutent sans discontinuer
sous_titre: Postes à pourvoir chaque année en moyenne, projection 2025 à 2035, États-Unis

Manoeuvres et aides.texte: About 137,000 openings for construction laborers and helpers are projected each year, on average, over the decade.

Électriciens.texte: About 72,700 openings for electricians are projected each year, on average, over the decade.

Charpentiers et menuisiers.texte: About 62,800 openings for carpenters are projected each year, on average, over the decade.

Plombiers et tuyauteurs.texte: About 42,000 openings for plumbers, pipefitters, and steamfitters are projected each year, on average, over the decade.
